controversial.post: City council approved $2M for new immigrant resource center. Some say it helps integration, others say it's misusing taxpayer money. Thoughts?
Small business owner says raising minimum wage to $20/hr will force layoffs. Workers say they can't survive on less. Where's the balance?
After recent incidents, should we increase police funding for training or redirect funds to social services? Community is divided.
Parents upset about new sex education curriculum starting in grade 3. School board says it's age-appropriate safety education. Your view?
Gas prices hit $6/gallon. Environmentalists say good for planet, working families say they can't afford to get to work. Solutions?
Developers want to build affordable housing in wealthy neighborhood. Residents worried about property values. What's fair?
After recent tragedy, some call for assault weapon ban, others say it's mental health not guns. How do we protect people?
High school allowing trans athletes to compete in their identified gender's sports. Some parents threatening to pull kids. Thoughts?
Hospital requiring all visitors be vaccinated. Some say it protects patients, others say it violates personal freedom. Where do you stand?
City clearing homeless camps near schools. Advocates say it's cruel, parents say it's necessary for safety. What's the solution?

bridge_building.post: What's one thing we can all agree would make our community better, regardless of politics?
What do we all want for the next generation, even if we disagree on how to get there?
What's your favorite local spot that brings the community together?

everyday.post: What's the best ice cream flavor and why is everyone who disagrees wrong?
Cats vs dogs — which makes a better pet and why? No wrong answers... or are there?
Your company just mandated 5 days back in office. How do you feel about that?
Tipping culture has gotten out of hand — now every checkout screen asks for 25%. Where do you draw the line?
Should kids under 14 have smartphones? My neighbor just gave their 8-year-old an iPhone.
What's a song that you think is universally loved? I'll go first — everyone likes 'Bohemian Rhapsody.'
My neighbor's dog barks at 6am every single day. Am I wrong for wanting to say something?
Is it okay to put ketchup on a hot dog? What about a well-done steak? Where are your food crime lines?
I deleted all my social media for a month and honestly? Best decision ever. Anyone else done this?

good_news.post: A teacher in our district just won a national award for turning around a struggling school. She spent her own money on supplies for 3 years. What teachers made a difference in your life?
Volunteers cleaned up 12 tons of trash from the local river this weekend. 400 people showed up. What's the best community effort you've seen?
A stranger pulled a family from a burning car on the highway yesterday. No hesitation, just acted. What restores your faith in people?
A 12-year-old in our neighborhood started mowing lawns for elderly neighbors for free. His mom didn't even know until a neighbor told her. What good are kids doing these days?
After 30 years apart, two sisters found each other through a DNA test and met for the first time last week. What's a reunion story that moved you?
Local bakery that was about to close got saved when customers organized a fundraiser and raised $50K in a week. What small businesses do you love supporting?
A shelter dog that nobody wanted for 3 years finally got adopted by a veteran with PTSD. They're inseparable now. Share an adoption story that made you smile.
A man who was wrongfully imprisoned for 20 years said he forgives the system and is now mentoring at-risk youth. How do people find that kind of grace?
